items.name: USB Selective Suspend: Off (AC) / On (DC)
items.description: Improves USB responsiveness on AC while preserving battery behavior on DC.

items.name: USB: Audit Root Hub Power-Management Flags
items.description: Enumerates USB hubs/controllers to assist manual selective power tuning.

steps.command: Get-PnpDevice -Class USB -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Status,FriendlyName,InstanceId | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output

items.name: USB Selective Suspend: Off (AC/DC)
items.description: Disables USB selective suspend for latency-sensitive peripherals.

items.name: USB Root Hub Power Management: Disable Sleep Toggle
items.description: Disables allow-turn-off flags on USB hubs where exposed by PnP power settings.

steps.command: Get-PnpDevice -Class USB | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match 'Root Hub|Generic USB Hub' } | ForEach-Object { try { powercfg /devicedisablewake "$($_.FriendlyName)" } catch {} }
